irregularities.title: Shared Pages publication gate was red: three TWC day-2 rows published a lobby filter URL as a "published permalink"
irregularities.detail: Found by this audit while re-running the repository's publication gate. data/picks_fixtures.json (session ac475c09, collected 2026-10-15T11:37:43Z) labelled fixtures 1080202 (9z vs Falcons), 1080203 (PARIVISION vs BetBoom) and 1080204 (Legacy vs FURIA) as hotspawn_match_url_kind='lobby_published_permalink' while the URL was 'https://www.hotspawn.com/?fixtures=waiting-for-information-<id>' - the lobby's own stage-filter link, which opens a listing rather than the fixture, and which also carried a stale stage string (the lobby now reports 'group stage and playoffs'). Their own contract test tests/test_picks_ac475c09.py::test_every_row_links_to_the_official_fixture_page requires a permalink of that kind to be /matches/<slug>-<id>, so the full suite went red, and because .github/workflows/pages.yml gates deployment on that suite, the site stopped publishing (five consecutive failed Pages runs, the last success ~55 minutes before this audit). Cause: the lobby payload has no match page for these three fixtures (data/hotspawn_matches.json records source_flags=['official_match_permalink_unavailable'], published_match_url=null), and scripts/picks_collect.py accepted whatever URL the payload carried. Repair (logged takeover, session task recorded done and claim >60 min old with only bot commits): a shape guard in scripts/picks_collect.py so only a /matches/<slug>-<fixture_id> URL may be labelled a published permalink, the three rows reset to the honest lobby_listing_fallback (https://play.hotspawn.com/lobby, verified=false, flagged on the row), and picks/ + data/picks_board.json regenerated offline with their own builder. No model, price, pick or test assertion was changed; their 16 tests pass and the gate is green again.

irregularities.title: Retained Kalshi / bo3.gg quote records store names in source order but the normalized probability in fixture order
irregularities.detail: Re-deriving every row showed the published values are correct, but the retained quote objects are internally inconsistent: for fixture 1081120 (mellren vs Privateer) the quote records team_a='Privateer Gaming' with decimal_a=4.1667 while prob_a=0.751295 is mellren's normalized share; for 1080289 (RoundsGG vs Voca) the quote records team_a='Voca' with decimal_a=1.10 while prob_a=0.15942 is ROUNDS' share. Each board resolves the orientation correctly at row level (verified: mellren 0.725/0.965=0.7513 and Voca 0.909091/1.081505=0.84058), so no published pick is affected, but the stored evidence reads reversed and this audit now records both the raw side probability and the orientation per quote so the join can be re-checked without guessing. Session b5436cf0 flagged the same pattern on 2026-10-14.

irregularities.title: Rank chips for the same team disagree across sources; only Valve's file and HLTV's played lineups were used
irregularities.detail: WBT appears as #60 in Valve's official standings of 2026-10-05, as #66 on the HLTV event 9332 group chip, and as #109 in an earlier session's note; ROUNDS appears as #310 (Valve) and #237 (HLTV chip). These are different ranking systems and different dates, not a data error, but they are easy to mis-cite. This audit re-checks every citation against Valve's own file only, and proves identity from played lineups rather than from a rank chip.

irregularities.title: Shared Pages gate red a second time: an evidence refresh retained a new league its own contract test did not allow
irregularities.detail: Found by check C11 after rebasing onto main at 4db03da. Session a0586093's own bot commit 4db03da 'evidence: expanded external source capture' (2026-10-15T13:46:55Z) started retaining a Mobile Legends - MPL Indonesia matchup in data/expanded/samples/pinnacle_esports_matchups.json, while tests/test_expanded_lines.py::test_pinnacle_sample_carries_matchup_and_price_shape still allowed only the league prefixes ('CS2 ', 'Dota', 'Leag', 'Rain', 'Valo'). The assertion failed with "'Mobi' not found in (...)", the full suite went red, and because pages.yml gates deployment on that suite the site again stopped publishing (three more failed dispatch runs, 21-30s each). Takeover justification: T-EXPAND is claimed 'in progress' since 2026-10-13 21:22 and this file's own coordination log already recorded it as take-over eligible from 22:56 that day if no commits; only bot commits have touched the scope since. Repair: one line - add 'Mobi' to the allowlist, with a comment recording who added it and why. The assertion's intent is unchanged (a known esports league, two participants); no sample, parser, collector, price or probability was altered. Their 28 tests pass. Structural note for whoever owns CI next: both red-gate incidents this session had the same shape - a scheduled bot commits refreshed data without running the contract tests that read it. Running each session's own tests inside its refresh workflow, before the commit step, would stop one session's cron from taking the whole site down.

irregularities.title: Locked fixtures publish no probability at all, so six rows are blank by design and the audit now verifies the disclosure
irregularities.detail: The strategy board refreshed at 2026-10-15T13:27:08Z publishes 11 open rows (all with a pick) and 6 locked rows whose bookmaker prices were withdrawn at the lock: 1079440 MIBR vs BC.Game, 1079442 Heroic vs Envy, 1080280 ENCE vs BOJONG, 1080202 9z vs Falcons, 1080281 WROTBERRY vs ENCE and one more, each with basis 'unresolved' and the flag 'no_line_from_any_board'. That is honest - a locked fixture cannot be picked and no price survives to verify - but it means checks C2/C3/C6/C8 must treat a blank row as a disclosure to audit rather than a missing value to crash on, and C10 legitimately finds no published context claims once the fixtures carrying them have locked (published as 'skipped', never as a pass over zero rows). Side effect worth stating plainly: the R3 contrarian swing on 9z vs Falcons, whose context this audit confirmed from HLTV, is no longer published because that match locked at 10:54Z; the confirmation stands as evidence, not as a live pick.
